p: Duke Street is the long road running east out of Glasgow city centre, and the Dennistoun stretch has become one of the city's liveliest local high streets, with cafés, brunch spots and independent shops popping up among the traditional tenements.

Alexandra Park is close by for a stroll, and the Tennent's Wellpark Brewery sits at the city end of Duke Street, near the Glasgow Necropolis and the Cathedral, so there's plenty of history if you head west. Admiral is an over-18s gaming centre, so it's strictly for adults. If you're after food, Dennistoun is well known these days for good coffee and some cracking places to eat.
